name: youtube-mcp
description: Search YouTube, manage your channel and read your analytics from your AI assistant. Every change to your account is previewed and needs your approval first.

YOUTUBE_API_KEY.title: YouTube Data API key
YOUTUBE_API_KEY.description: Your YouTube Data API v3 key. Enough for the public search, video, channel, comment and transcript tools.

YOUTUBE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE.title: OAuth client JSON file (optional)
YOUTUBE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE.description: Desktop OAuth client JSON from Google Cloud. Only needed for account and creator tools. Leave empty for public tools only.

YOUTUBE_MCP_PROFILE_ID.title: Profile name (optional)
YOUTUBE_MCP_PROFILE_ID.description: A name you choose, for example creator-main. Keeps local state separate per profile. Only needed for creator tools.

YOUTUBE_MCP_CHANNEL_ID.title: Channel ID (optional)
YOUTUBE_MCP_CHANNEL_ID.description: Your YouTube channel ID, starting with UC. The signed-in Google account must own it. Only needed for creator tools.

YOUTUBE_MCP_STATE_DIR.title: State directory (optional)
YOUTUBE_MCP_STATE_DIR.description: Where local state (OAuth token, approvals, local history database) lives. Leave empty to use ~/.youtube-mcp.
